entries.title: A Christmas Carol 2026
entries.description: Walk through Montalvo’s historic Villa and courtyards as Silicon Valley Shakespeare brings Dickens’s A Christmas Carol to life in an immersive, roving holiday performance.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 跟随硅谷莎士比亚剧团走过 Montalvo 的历史别墅与庭院，在沉浸式步行演出中体验狄更斯的《圣诞颂歌》。

entries.title: Indian Carnatic Music Concert
entries.description: Saratoga Library in collaboration with SR Fine Arts invites you to an Indian Carnatic Music concert by Bay Area musicians from the Indian community.

entries.title: LEGO Club for Grades K-8
entries.description: Children will use their creativity and engineering skills to free build anything they can imagine.
entries.priorTitleZh: K–8 年级 LEGO 积木俱乐部
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 孩子们可以运用创造力和工程技能，自由搭建想象中的作品。无需预先参加固定课程，可随时到场。

entries.title: Growing Readers: Help Your Aspiring Writer
entries.description: A free workshop for parents and caregivers presented by Santa Clara County Office of Education and The Reading Program of Santa Clara County Library District.
entries.priorTitleZh: 培养阅读者：帮助有写作兴趣的孩子
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 面向家长和照护者的免费工作坊，由 Santa Clara County Office of Education 与 Santa Clara County Library District 的 The Reading Program 举办，帮助孩子建立写作自信。

entries.title: Locked in: Teen Finals Study Space!
entries.description: Join us at the Mitchell Park Library for some extra study space (and snacks!)
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 到 Mitchell Park 图书馆找一处额外的复习空间，现场还有小点心。

entries.title: Library Ukulele Society of Morgan Hill
entries.description: Learn some songs and play together.
entries.priorTitleZh: Morgan Hill 图书馆尤克里里社团
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 带上自己的尤克里里和乐谱架，也可以来聆听并跟着一起唱。

entries.title: Story Explorers: TK-1st Grade Book Club
entries.description: We'll read together, have a short discussion of each book, move to music, and end with a fun craft!
entries.priorTitleZh: 故事探索者：TK–1 年级读书会
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 无需提前读完书。大家将一起阅读、简短讨论每本书、随音乐活动，并以趣味手工结束。

entries.title: Virtual Author Talk: Robin Ha
entries.description: This book uses comic‑style recipes to show simple steps, helpful tips, and tasty dishes, giving beginners and seasoned cooks a playful way to learn Korean cuisine at home.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 如需填写表格方面的帮助，请咨询当地公共图书馆工作人员，致电 (408) 540-3947，或发送邮件至 ask@lib.sccgov.org。

entries.title: Poetry in the Dark
entries.description: Let’s gather to listen deeply, celebrate difference, and honor the many languages that shape our community.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 今年十二月，欢迎到 Cupertino 图书馆参加灯光柔和的诗歌分享之夜。不同年龄、文化和语言背景的参与者将一起分享口语与文字的力量。每人可向小组朗读自己的诗作。活动由 Cupertino 桂冠诗人 Thomas Célérier 主持，欢迎所有人参加，无需经验。

entries.title: LEGO Club
entries.description: Children can follow our prompts or build based on their imagination.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 孩子们可以按照活动提示搭建，也可以自由发挥想象力。Gilroy 图书馆的 LEGO 俱乐部每月第二个星期五举行，图书馆提供积木，孩子们动手创作。
